definitions.pairs: verified fingerstick pairs: independent meter pairs (not used for calibration) in the study window (day 0-329) whose reference came from a glucose-meter upload (source == meter). Pump-entered BG values are excluded because many are CGM values typed into the pump (see data_quality)
definitions.allpairs_mard: the same but on ALL independent pairs including pump-entered BG values (the older definition; shown as a sensitivity check)
definitions.pump_mard: MARD on pump-entered BG pairs only (pump copies of meter readings dropped; at least 20 pairs)
definitions.pct_pairs_low / fast / night: share of the person's verified pairs with average < 70 mg/dL / |rate of change| > 1 mg/dL per min / between 00:00 and 06:00
definitions.mid_mard: MARD on pairs with average 70-180 mg/dL (at least 20 pairs)
definitions.mard: mean of |CGM - reference| / reference x 100 over the person's pairs
definitions.bias_pct: mean of (CGM - reference) / reference x 100; negative = sensor reads low
definitions.pct_within_20_20: percent of pairs within 20 mg/dL when reference < 100 mg/dL, else within 20 %
definitions.low_mard: MARD on pairs whose average of CGM and reference is below 70 mg/dL; NaN when fewer than 20 such pairs
definitions.cgm_metrics: CGM readings in the window, duplicates dropped: % time < 70, % time > 180, mean, SD, CV = SD / mean x 100, median readings per day

device_family.note: per-participant MARD on each device's pairs (at least 20 pairs); pump copies of meter readings dropped

pump_vs_meter_within_person.label: Pump-entered BG pairs vs meter-upload pairs (same person)

data_quality.note: In the CGM-only arm people dosed from the CGM and typed its value into the pump bolus calculator. Those entries are not fingersticks. They make the old all-pairs MARD too low and create a false arm difference.
